label: Inputs of the interactive Figure 5.1: the tax morale model's driver scores, weights, intervention deltas, fitted alpha and beta and the combined discount (economic_model.py build_tax_morale_model). MODELLED; the effects are assumed uplifts.
observed_anchor_source: FinScope Tanzania 2023, weighted adult (16+) TIN rate, outputs/tables/tin_by_segment.csv (361 of 9,915 respondents)

USSD_registration_nudge.stage_name: Ujumuishaji wa Kikodi (Taxpayer Targeting and Registration Tool)

combination_rule: one active intervention: its solo odds ratio exp(beta x index change); two or more: the drivers' deltas are summed after multiplying each by tax_morale.combined_discount (0.6), capped at 1, then exp(beta x index change) (the rule that gives the combined effect of all six). Block E3.1: the agent and tier simulations multiply each agent's yearly registration odds by the odds ratio of the set of interventions that reach the agent
